# odinex_nat_gateway (Resource)

Manages the NAT gateway of a private network (one per network). Servers without public IPs in the network reach the internet from the gateway's public IPv4; the gateway takes the first host of the network (its `gateway`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_nat_gateway" "private" {
  name       = "private"
  network_id = odinex_network.private.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the network. Changing it creates a new NAT gateway.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Up to 64 pairs; keys and values up to 63 characters.
- `name` (String) Name of the NAT gateway.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.
- `location` (String) Location of the NAT gateway (the network's location).
- `private_ip` (String) Address of the gateway inside the network (the default gateway of its servers).
- `public_ip` (String) Public IPv4 address the network's traffic leaves from.
- `status` (String) Status of the NAT gateway (`creating`, `available`, `deleting`).

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import odinex_nat_gateway.private 6
```
